title: DeepSeek raises $15 billion following US federal deployment restrictions
summary: DeepSeek raised $15 billion shortly after US federal civilian agencies were ordered to discontinue use of its models over national security considerations.
research_notes:
Review regional regulatory boundaries and federal compliance directives before integrating DeepSeek API or model weights into institutional workflows.

Provision commercial API access or private compute clusters backed by independent infrastructure to maintain operational continuity.

Isolate deployment pipelines of Chinese-headquartered model providers from federal and regulated Western data environments to comply with public procurement restrictions.
